title: Frozen broad cross-tissue causal mechanical-state gate
text: Broad causal mechanical state gate already PASS with HEART SKIN SPINAL_CORD. Old third-tissue search is obsolete. No universal stiffness threshold or softer-is-better rule. Next killer gate is delayed mechanical retuning after repair state establishment.

title: Frozen strict delayed mechanical-state timing gate
text: MECHANICAL_CLOCK_v0_2 remains OPEN. One strict 5-of-5 SKIN root admitted; one additional independent delayed direct physical retuning root is required. Preconditioning, immediate intervention, molecular-only intervention, or static mechanics do not satisfy the strict timing gate.

title: Hyaluronic acid and tissue mechanics orchestrate mammalian digit tip regeneration
text: Science 2026 DOI 10.1126/science.ady3136. Nonregenerative mouse digit regions are stiffer with dense organized collagen; regenerative regions are softer and HA-rich. HA depletion inhibits regeneration and promotes fibrosis. HAPLN1-mediated HA stabilization after nonregenerative amputation tunes ECM mechanics, reduces scarring, and enhances bone repair.

title: Mui et al. 2026 full-text lineage
text: Author manuscript of DOI 10.1126/science.ady3136. Reports AFM/force mapping, HA/collagen niche differences, HA perturbation, HAPLN1 overexpression and regenerative outcomes. Same publication lineage as PMID 41955369; must not count as independent evidence.

title: Raw scRNA-seq expression matrices from Mui et al. digit study
text: Public raw scRNA-seq expression matrices generated for non-regenerative digits after amputation, with or without inhibition of hyaluronic acid. Dataset can test cellular-state response to HA perturbation but does not by itself isolate physical mechanics from matrix chemistry.

title: Analysis code for Mui et al. Science 2026
text: Public analysis code associated with DOI 10.1126/science.ady3136 and GSE274858. Code availability supports reproducibility of reported analysis but software agreement is not independent biological evidence.

title: Archived code release for Mui et al. Science 2026
text: Zenodo archive of analysis code linked by the paper. Same software/evidence lineage as the public GitHub code and publication; archive hash/provenance may strengthen reproducibility but not biological independence.
